title: Prepayment Terms, Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage
content:
Note terms governing voluntary prepayment of the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage, by plan.

| Plan | Prepayment penalty, percent of the amount prepaid | Prepaid amounts credited back to the line during the draw period | Order of application of a partial prepayment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | 0% | no | interest, then principal |
| Summit Flex Fixed | 0% | yes | interest, then principal |
| Summit Select Line | 0% | yes | interest, then principal |
| Summit Condo Line | 0% | yes | interest, then principal |
| Summit Second Lien | 0% | no | interest, then principal |
| Summit Estate Line | 0% | yes | interest, then principal |

## Terms common to every plan

- No Summit plan charges a prepayment penalty: the penalty is 0% of the amount prepaid.
- A partial prepayment goes first to accrued unpaid interest and only the remainder to principal.

## Where the plans differ

The four line plans — Summit Flex Fixed, Summit Select Line, Summit Condo Line and Summit Estate Line — credit prepaid amounts back to the line during the draw period. The Summit Fixed Lump Sum and the Summit Second Lien have no line and credit nothing back.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical partial prepayment of USD 3150.00 on a Summit loan carrying USD 1207.43 of accrued unpaid interest is applied USD 1207.43 to interest and the remaining USD 1942.57 to principal; no penalty is added under any plan.
